page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m2.4xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual server operating on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile is configured with 16 dedicated virtual CPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated graphics processing units and features no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for the operating system and persistent data volumes.

Networking capabilities are defined by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in the base deployment. The architectural allocation of 16 dedicated cores against a moderate 32.0 GB memory footprint yields efficient resource density for CPU-heavy tasks without the added cost overhead of surplus RAM. Operational tradeoffs include reliance on network disks for storage throughput and the absence of hardware acceleration hardware.

Given its hardware specifications and lean memory-to-core balance, the ecs.u0.c1m2.4xlarge instance is suited for multi-threaded CPU tasks, continuous integration and build pipelines, batch computation, and scalable web serving tiers.
